implement.approach: rateLimit.ts: auth-failure budget split into two aligned windows sharing AUTH_FAILURE_LIMIT (30/300s). Egress window (scope 'authfail', id=IP) now counts DISTINCT refused credentials per window — charged only when a credential's per-(IP, sha256(credential) prefix) shard (scope 'authfail_id') records its FIRST failure (atomic INCR ordinal == 1, never read-then-write) — plus credential-less refusals (no bearer: nothing a peer could share, charged per hit as before). Shard window bounds one client's replay to AUTH_FAILURE_LIMIT on its own. Pre-auth gate peekAuthFailureBudget() peeks egress then shard, reporting the closed window's Retry-After. 401s are tagged via a WeakMap<Response, AuthRefusal> (authRefusal/authRefusalOf): kind 'liveness' (session fenced at this edge after logout — cached revoked entry or verification racing revocation — or Supabase Auth 403 session-gone) charges only the shard, never the egress; kind 'credential' (bad/expired/forged bearer, refused refresh token — identity = hash of the refresh token, deletion-status capability as bearer) charges shard + egress-on-first. Unavailable Auth (429/5xx/network) still 503s uncharged (unchanged). Regression test rateLimit_nat_budget.test.ts drives the real handler through routesHarness with fetch interception for Auth verdicts; 4 scenarios: replayed refused bearer isolated to its shard while a peer stays signed in; rotating refused bearers still trip egress (stuffing protection kept); liveness 401s (edge-fenced after logout and upstream 403) bounded per shard and never charged to egress; replayed refused refresh token charges egress once while peers keep refreshing.
out_of_scope_files: supabase/functions/api/index.ts — edge-index serial group IS held by this package (manifest serial_groups: ["edge-index"]). Minimal wiring only: import list, the pre-auth gate peeks the sharded budget for the presented bearer (peekAuthFailureBudget), recordAuthFailure charges via chargeAuthFailure with the refusing Response, the four 401 charge sites pass their response, and the five refusal sites in authenticate()/refreshSessionRoute() tag their 401 with authRefusal(); no existing code moved or reformatted, no existing comments modified.
residual_risks: Egress budget semantics changed from 'every refusal' to 'distinct refused credentials + credential-less refusals': a single client rotating forged bearers still trips it in 30 attempts, but 30 replays of ONE dead credential no longer close the egress (by design, per objective). Documented in rateLimit.ts doc comments.

Shard keys add up to one extra rate-limit window per distinct refused credential per IP; memory fallback capacity (MEMORY_WINDOW_MAX = 20 000 live windows) is shared with all other budgets — an attacker rotating many credentials from one IP is still bounded by the egress window (30) before it can consume meaningful capacity.

Liveness classification relies on Supabase Auth returning 403 for a revoked/gone session (existing verdict mapping in authenticate()); a 401 from Auth for a still-signed but revoked token is charged as a credential refusal (conservative: never under-charges an attacker).
